, there was a big, scary cat. The cat lived in a house with a girl named Sue. Sue had a pretty blouse with flowers on it. The cat liked to sit on the chair and watch Sue.

Sue and the cat became best friends. They played and laughed together. The cat was not scary anymore. The cat was happy to have a friend like Sue. They lived happily ever after.
